description: No relative imports anywhere in modules/
fix: Use absolute imports: from modules.backend.core.config import ...

description: No direct import logging — use centralized get_logger()
scope: modules/ (excluding core/logging.py and services/compliance.py scanner strings)
check: rg "^import logging$" modules/ --type py -l | rg -v "core/logging\.py" | rg -v "services/compliance\.py"
fix: Replace with: from modules.backend.core.logging import get_logger

description: __init__.py files must be minimal — docstring and re-exports only
fix: Move logic to dedicated modules, keep __init__.py to docstring + imports + __all__

description: Agents must not import from other agents (except mission_control which orchestrates them)
fix: Agents are black boxes. Share code via agents/tools/ or agents/schemas.py. Mission control is the only legitimate cross-agent caller.

description: Tool implementations must not import PydanticAI
fix: Tools are pure functions. PydanticAI wiring happens in the agent module via @agent.tool

description: API layer must not import repositories directly — go through services
fix: API handlers call services. Services call repositories. No layer skipping.

description: CLI handlers must not import models or repositories directly (except health check validation)
fix: CLI handlers call services or use config. No direct data layer access. Health check may import base classes for validation only.
